annotation.title_clean: Commission Regulation (EU) No 722/2012 concerning particular requirements as regards the requirements laid down in Council Directives 90/385/EEC and 93/42/EEC with respect to active implantable medical devices and medical devices manufactured utilising tissues of animal origin
annotation.title_en: Commission Regulation (EU) No 722/2012 concerning particular requirements as regards the requirements laid down in Council Directives 90/385/EEC and 93/42/EEC with respect to active implantable medical devices and medical devices manufactured utilising tissues of animal origin
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 212/3
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Regulation setting particular requirements for active implantable and other medical devices made with animal tissue, to minimise TSE transmission risk. It mandates manufacturer risk analysis, notified-body conformity assessment, and Member State scrutiny. It is unrelated to AI or robotics. It replaced Directive 2003/32/EC.
key_provisions_or_claims: Manufacturers must carry out TSE risk analysis and risk management before conformity assessment.
Notified bodies must assess benefit versus residual risk and consider alternatives to animal tissue.
Summary evaluation reports go to other Member States, with 4- or 12-week comment periods.
Member States must verify notified bodies' expertise.
